# cato_webhook (Resource)

Manages one webhook integration. `body` and `auth` are write-only: the API never echoes webhook secrets (or the body payload template, which may embed them) back on read, so Terraform retains the configured values across refreshes instead of showing drift. Creating this resource does not send a test request. Import using its ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `auth` (Attributes) Authentication configuration. Exactly one of `basic`, `bearer`, or `custom` is required. Write-only: secret subfields are never refreshed from the API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth))
- `body` (String, Sensitive) Request body payload template. Write-only: never refreshed from the API; Terraform always retains the last configured value.
- `name` (String) Name
- `url` (String) Destination URL the webhook request is sent to.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the webhook is enabled.
- `header` (Attributes List) Additional HTTP headers sent with the request. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--header))
- `related_webhook_ref` (Attributes) Reference to a related webhook (e.g. the "create" webhook of an "update" webhook pair), by ID or name. Write-only: the API only returns the related webhook's ID on read (never its name), so this attribute is carried forward from the prior configuration instead of being refreshed from the API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--related_webhook_ref))
- `request_method` (String) HTTP request method.
- `response_mapping` (Attributes List) Key/value pairs mapped out of the webhook response. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--response_mapping))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource ID

<a id="nestedatt--auth"></a>

Optional:

- `basic` (Attributes) HTTP Basic authentication. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth--basic))
- `bearer` (Attributes) Bearer token authentication. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth--bearer))
- `custom` (Attributes) Custom header authentication. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth--custom))
